title: payload: dataset.subscribe
description: RESERVED — not implemented: this message lets a BF ask AFB for an additional dataset subscription. AFB today derives the full set of needed (dataset_id, instrument) pairs itself from the dataset conditions on deals published to a given BF (see dataset.update.json) and pushes accordingly, so no BF currently sends dataset.subscribe and AFB is not obligated to act on it if received. The shape is reserved on the wire for a future BF-initiated use case (e.g. a BF wanting a dataset ahead of publishing a deal that needs it). Neither BF nor AFB implement this today.
